definitions.average_latency: arithmetic mean of successful end-to-end latencies
definitions.error_rate: failed measured user requests divided by all measured user requests
definitions.internal_throughput: successful internal Elasticsearch requests divided by measured scenario wall time
definitions.latency: end-to-end client latency for each successful measured request
definitions.p95_latency: nearest-rank P95 over successful end-to-end latencies
definitions.user_facing_throughput: successful user requests divided by measured scenario wall time
